notes.title: Long-awaited update
notes.notes:
We, finally, after a long time, found an opportunity to complete the update, which we were preparing last year, but due to all the events that happened in the world, we delayed its release. So, meet: 

 Location system: now, under the compass, your current location is indicated, and with an active task, there is also the location on which the current goal of the task is located. As we said before, we found this method to be optimal in order to preserve the atmosphere of the game and make orientation on the terrain more convenient. In addition, this is a great incentive to explore the territory of the Last Commune, and find a lot of useful things before taking on tasks.
 Ability to switch language in the game settings. Since the translation quality is not the same in all languages, you may find it more convenient to play in a language other than the language of your operating system. Now you can choose the language that is most convenient for you, the game interface will be translated as soon as you apply the new settings.
 Fog density settings. There are those who like the dense fog in our game, and there are those who are uncomfortable with it. Now you can adjust the fog for yourself, or turn it off completely in the game settings.

And, according to tradition, we thank the active members of the game community, without your help and support, this update could drag on for an even longer period. Follow our news, it will be even more interesting further.

notes.title: Changes in settings system
notes.notes:
We have completely redesigned the settings system. From now on, all parameters of the game are configured in the game itself in the "Settings" menu, in addition, finally, the volume settings for music and game sounds are added.
Launcher as unnecessary disabled, now the game starts immediately.

notes.title: New localization and bug fixes
notes.notes: Thanks to the support of the community in the game appeared Japanese! Thanks to all active community users involved in this event! In addition, we have corrected the mistakes of the free camera - now it will not move when you explore the depths of the inventory or perform any operations that require the participation of the mouse.

notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
At the request of the community, we connected a free camera in the game. By default, the "c" key is responsible for switching the camera.
We also slightly reduced the rate of decrease of the characteristics responsible for food, water and sleep.
And also corrected the order of display tips at the bottom of the screen.
